text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's this...!? Somehow, my body... 
feels all warm inside.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...This is your encouragement, right, 
Three Goddesses? Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Gotta deliver on what I was given.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to stand around doing 
nothing. —I'm gonna do this. More. Even 
more than before!
